title: Recorded evidence scope
responsibility: Build the selected entity and revision scope from recorded facts, refusing a stale current view or an unregistered entity.

inputs.name: recordedTip.query
inputs.description: Entity ID, branch, commit and current-or-commit viewing mode to check.

inputs.name: recordedTip.tip
inputs.description: Actual tip commit of the selected branch.

inputs.name: recordedScope.query
inputs.description: Entity ID, branch, commit and viewing mode to describe.

inputs.name: recordedScope.facts
inputs.description: Branch tip, registered kind, commit metadata, judged evidence and legacy record IDs.

outputs.name: recordedTip
outputs.description: Returns nothing when the requested current commit is still the branch tip; otherwise throws.

outputs.name: recordedScope
outputs.description: Scope containing the selected location, tip comparison, first parent or null and supplied evidence summary.

errors.name: stale-tip
errors.description: The current-mode commit no longer equals the supplied branch tip.

errors.name: entity-unregistered
errors.description: The supplied entity kind is absent or has no supported explorer category.
